works.title: Apple iPhone White Paper
works.description: A critical white paper designed as a hit piece against Apple's iPhone transcription system and broader corporate practices. Structured with technical analysis layer (documenting transcription failures and costs) fused with persuasive/emotional layer (rage library and translation guide). Planned for public-domain release with distributed mirroring across free sites, git repositories, PDF hosts, and Substack promotion.
works.quote: There is a product called a white paper. I'm not sure exactly how I will distribute it, but there is a product that will come out of my experience with Apple transcription. It's essentially going to be an Apple iPhone hit piece—like an assassin shooting a bullet at the iPhone.
